filter.name: SeverityMatchFilter
filter.description:
Filter SeverityMatchFilter decides audit events according to the severity level of the event.

SeverityMatchFilter can suppress Checks that have Treewalker or Checker as parent module.

In Checkstyle, when a filter accepts an audit event (i.e. accept() returns true), the violation is kept in the final report; to make a violation disappear from the report, the filter must reject the event by returning false. For SeverityMatchFilter, this means the severity and acceptOnMatch properties must be configured so that unwanted events are not matched under acceptOnMatch="true", or are matched under acceptOnMatch="false".

property.name: acceptOnMatch
property.description: Control whether the filter accepts an audit event if and only if there is a match between the event's severity level and property severity. If acceptOnMatch is false, then the filter accepts an audit event if and only if there is not a match between the event's severity level and property severity.

property.name: severity
property.description: Specify the severity level of this filter.
